notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/ministral-3-3b-25-12). It is a product/model catalog page (release date, context, license, params, modalities tooltips, features, pricing), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Specs come from the page HTML/RSC (header, modalities tooltips Text/Image input and Text output, Weights table Parameters/Active/Context for Instruct, Reasoning, and Base). The page links to Blog (mistral.ai/news/mistral-3) and Technical Report (arxiv.org/abs/2601.08584 / seed key mistral-ministral-3-paper); those were not used because seed-lookup listed only this document for the card. Performance UI says to select a model for benchmarks and shows no numeric scores for this page. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup.
